name: settings-inputs-ledger-aligns
description: the Inputs pane's shortcut ledger. Opens Settings, selects the Inputs pane by its rail id, and reads the ledger DOM the hotkeys pane redress produced: rows at '.hotkey-ledger > .settings-row[data-action]', a bound row's combo drawn as '.combo kbd.key' spans (settings.js comboKeycaps). Uses the same fixture and cmd+comma / '.settings-rail-item[data-pane]' pattern settings-cmd-comma.json already proved for this rail.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
Atrium must be frontmost or cmd+comma opens Finder Settings instead
let PushSettings and PushHotkeys' thread-pool reads land
the ledger's data source loaded before the pane is asked to read it

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="inputs"]'); if (!item) { return 'no inputs rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: renderInputs is a synchronous DOM rebuild, slack for the ssh/eval round trip
evidence: keycaps in one aligned ledger column

assertions.desc: the ledger lists at least one action row
a bound row draws its combo as keycap spans, not plain text
the browser window and the settings window
